programme.title: Bachelor of Science UZH in Informatics

language_twins.title: Bachelor of Science UZH in Informatik

programme.degree: Bachelor of Science UZH in Informatics, 6 semesters, 180 ECTS
programme.how_found: oec.uzh.ch academic programmes; Department of Informatics bachelor page.
programme.notes: Owner ruling: 'Informatik' counts as CS; the degree is split into majors (Software Systems closest to CS).

english.quote: Note that a German certificate (C1 level) is required for the Bachelor's program in Informatics.

gpa.notes: Foreign certificates are admitted by country-specific rules (swissuniversities), not by a published grade threshold on UZH pages read.

deadline.quote: Prospective students who require a visa and are therefore dependent on receiving the admission decision in a timely manner for their visa application 1 January until 28 February
deadline.notes: Fall semester admission, applicants with visa requirements; others 1 January until 30 April. The page prints no year.

value.population: all students; foreign students at Bachelor level pay a surcharge

tuition.quote: Tuition Fee per Semester Amount in CHF Students 720.—
tuition.notes: Plus 'Surcharge for foreign students at Bachelor level 500.—' per semester and CHF 59 mandatory semester contributions. Per semester, academic year not stated; not summed or multiplied.

scholarship_exists.quote: Once you have successfully completed your first year of studies, equivalent to at least 55 ECTS credits, you will be eligible to submit an application to our office.
scholarship_exists.notes: Need-based, supplementary, for international Bachelor's students only after the first year (55 ECTS); nothing for incoming applicants.

scholarship_international.quote: Once you have successfully completed your first year of studies, equivalent to at least 55 ECTS credits, you will be eligible to submit an application to our office.
scholarship_international.notes: Quoted under 'International Bachelor's students'; not at entry.
